body.description: The plan comment in Markdown: the ADR in a few lines, the critic verdict, the number of iterations, and what the owner does next. Without the '## Relay' heading and without a footer.

spec_path.description: Where the full plan was written: the spec path given in the context file.

verdict.description: APPROVE when the critic approved the final draft; NO_CONSENSUS when three iterations ran out.

iterations.description: How many planner → architect → critic rounds ran.
